source: third-round prod experiments, each re-checked by an independent reviewer

experiments.title: Closed-loop liquidation with a mid-day alpha signal (short windows with one learner vs boundary refinement), with a recall-keying probe and keyed multi-context acquisition
experiments.headline: On 32 held-out signals, boundary refinement (CL-R) raised Machina's seed-12 open-loop plan from 0.110 to 0.145 (+0.035, CI 0.022 to 0.048 over signals; seeds 0.138 to 0.149, tied with or slightly above same-budget CEM-linear at 0.144 on 3 seeds and 0.138 on 13). The 3-level closed-loop reference is 0.191; per-signal-optimal afternoons after the same morning reach 0.186, so CL-R used about half the headroom. On the weaker seed-13 OL base, CL-R gained +0.029 (-0.031 to -0.002). The single short-window learner (CL-1L) collapsed to -3.62 because frozen recall returned one global record (an s=-1 afternoon window) for every window (all four probe variants UNKEYED, so Stage 2 was skipped).

key_numbers.measure: CL-R boundary refinement (12 updates, seed 21), held-out
Same-budget CEM linear afternoon correction, held-out

key_numbers.note: every recall = record 116 (s=-1 afternoon); morning sold 98%
OL-optimal morning + per-signal best afternoon 0.198; best linear correction 0.192; clairvoyant 0.311

corrections: 'Closed-loop optimum 0.191' is not an upper bound (0.198 with the OL-optimal morning and the best afternoon per signal).
The +0.035 CI covers signal variation for one OL base only; the absolute 0.145 depends on the OL seed (seed-13 base: -0.031 -> -0.002).
The CEM tie rests on 3 seeds; 13 seeds give 0.138, so CL-R is at least as good.

experiments.title: Restoration after unobserved dynamics shifts in refinement: global actuator tilt (warm vs cold lineage, shift-back) and partial impact shift (new-only vs mixed practice)
experiments.headline: An unobserved actuator tilt dropped the refined AC policy from 75-83% to between -23% and 5% of the new best on 512 fresh contexts. After 20 updates under the tilt, continued practice in the same lineage recovered to 67-69%, versus 45-61% for a fresh learner (W-C +5.5 to +23.9 pts, 3/3 seeds; the bootstrap CIs are over contexts only, and in 2 of 3 seeds the gap is smaller than W's head start at the shift). Within the planned 20 updates, 1 of 3 seeds reached 90% of its pre-shift share (s53 at 19); beyond-spec extensions reached it at 24-25 updates (s21 back to 82.9% vs 83.2% after 40). Under a single-seed partial impact shift, new-only practice lifted affected contexts from 69% to 77% with 1 pt forgetting (2 pts on evalc), and mixed practice from 69% to 75% with unaffected contexts +2.4 pts. The run exceeded its 7,600-call hard cap by 43 calls.

key_numbers.measure: Warm lineage W after 20 tilted updates
Fresh learner C after 20 tilted updates
W minus C at 20 tilted updates
key_numbers.note: context-bootstrap CIs exclude 0; 3/3 seeds (one-sided p=0.125); W head start at the shift 34.1/25.3/6.8 pts

key_numbers.measure: Seeds back to 90% of pre-shift within 20 updates
key_numbers.note: extension: s21 at 24, s52 at 25; s21 0.829 after 40 (pre 0.832)

key_numbers.measure: Partial shift, affected contexts (s21): at shift / NEW / MIX after 10 updates
key_numbers.note: unaffected: NEW -1.0 pt, MIX +2.4 pts; evalc overall NEW 0.767, MIX 0.789

corrections: Hard call cap exceeded by 43 calls (beyond-spec extension; full-evaluation fallbacks under-reserved).
Restoration '19-25 updates' mixes the planned 20-update horizon (1/3 seeds) with the post-hoc extension.
W-C CIs are over contexts of one run per seed; in s21 and s52 the fresh learner improved more than W after the shift.
Partial shift is one seed; on evalc NEW lost 2.0 pts on unaffected contexts and MIX was better overall (78.9 vs 76.7%).

experiments.title: Learning from realized (noisy) costs: refinement under common random numbers (SNR ladder, independent-noise and pure-noise controls) and acquisition with fixed scenario sets
experiments.headline: Measured on 512 fresh contexts with 2 learner seeds per arm, refinement from realized costs on common simulated days kept 91% (CRN100), 73% (CRN10) and 37% (CRN1) of the noise-free gain. Per-seed spreads are wide: 0.80-1.01, 0.45-1.02 and 0.23-0.52. Under independent days per candidate (-2%) or pure noise (-2%) it kept about 0%, and retention rose with sign agreement (logistic midpoint 0.64). Single-learner acquisition on fixed scenario sets reached 81% of the best schedule with a favourable 25-day set (median over random 25-day sets: 66%) and 95% with 100 days. That is on par with Powell at the same budget (81% and 93%). With 100 fresh days per episode it reached 0%: the winner's curse kept a lucky TWAP schedule.

key_numbers.measure: Share: CRN100 / CRN10 / CRN1 / IND100 / NULL
Gain retention R pooled: CRN100 / CRN10 / CRN1 / IND100 / NULL
Logistic midpoint of R vs sign agreement
Acquisition exact share: SAA25 / SAA100 / FRESH100
key_numbers.note: SAA-optimum median over random sets: 25 days 0.66, 100 days 0.93

key_numbers.measure: Contextual CEM on identical streams: EXACT / NULL
key_numbers.note: no confirmation gate; CEM barely learns even with exact outcomes

corrections: SAA25 81% comes from a favourable day set (median random 25-day set 66%); acquisition is on par with Powell, not better.
CRN arms need shared simulated or replayed days; the live-trading analogue (IND100) kept about 0%.
Only 2 learner seeds per refinement arm; the CRN10 vs CRN100 ordering is not established.
The 120-update pure-noise extension caused a significant -5.6 pt loss on one seed.

experiments.title: New finance tasks where context matters: real S&P 500 volatility targeting (real-data edge) and alpha-signal liquidation (schedule shape flip, low linear ceiling)
experiments.headline: On 1,000 S&P dates from 2013-2018 (consecutive days with overlapping 20-day windows, so only about 75 independent windows), the Machina linear vol-target map reached 0.43 of perfect tracking (block-bootstrap CI [0.28,0.55]). That beats GARCH at 0.35 (+0.07 [0.03,0.13]) but cannot be told apart from the textbook rule at 0.32 (+0.11 [-0.05,0.31]). Same-budget local CEM reached 0.51 (mean 0.49 over 10 seeds), guided-quadratic 0.21, and the post-hoc linear-plus-guidance extension 0.48 (+0.06 [0.02,0.09] over plain linear). On alpha-aware liquidation the guided-quadratic learner reached 0.72 of best-known on 512 fresh contexts after 40 updates (0.47 at 20). The linear learner reached 0.25 at 20 updates, and same-budget CEM at 40 updates reached 0.23-0.28 for the reported seeds (0.08-0.39 over 8 seeds). All numbers reproduce exactly; the run used 6,046 of 6,300 calls, and all 5 Domains were deleted.

key_numbers.measure: Vol target, share of perfect, 1,000 dates: textbook / GARCH
Vol target: guided quadratic (G) / linear+guidance (GL, post hoc)
Vol target: L minus GARCH / GL minus L
Alpha liquidation, 512 fresh: linear @20 / guided quadratic @20 / @40
Alpha liquidation: same-budget CEM @40 linear / quadratic

corrections: Guided-quadratic G@40 vs linear L@20 is not equal budget; at 20 updates G 0.47 vs L 0.25.
CEM figures are single seeds; the headline 'CEM 0.23-0.28' is one seed per basis.
The linear basis (retained_variance 0.99) drops support PC4, so the attainable LS slope is -0.71, not -0.89.
Linear+guidance was chosen after seeing held-out L and G results (no tuning on held-out data).

experiments.title: Refinement reliability: seed variance x acquisition-base quality on two_asset_transition
experiments.headline: On two_asset_transition, 20 updates of linear refinement raised the held-out share of best-known (512 fresh contexts) from 0/25/38% to 41.8/47.0/54.2% for bases B0/B1/B2. The pooled replicate SD was 3.5 points (95% CI 2.2-7.7, df 6). Base quality still mattered: F(2,6)=9.7, p=0.013, or F(2,4)=20.8, p=0.008 with seed as a blocking factor. Refinement absorbed about 69% of the base differences (slope 0.31, OLS CI 0.13-0.49), unevenly: 79% of the B0-B1 gap but only 41% of the B1-B2 gap. Machina beat same-budget contextual CEM in 9 of 9 cells by 19.6 points (CI 10.7-28.4).

key_numbers.measure: Base share B0 / B1 / B2, 512 fresh
Final share after 20 updates, mean of 3 seeds

key_numbers.note: OLS CI; 79% of B0-B1 gap closed, 41% of B1-B2

key_numbers.measure: Machina minus contextual CEM, paired cells

corrections: Headline quotes the narrowest (stratified) slope CI; OLS CI is 0.13-0.49.
Absorption is uneven: 79% of the B0-B1 gap, 41% of the B1-B2 gap.
Radius halves only after two consecutive rejections, then grows x1.25 back to 0.1.
CEM pairing is by label only (different context draws); CMA-ES recipe is worse than naive, so +77 pts over it says little.

experiments.title: API semantics sweep: context clipping and out-of-range saturation, multi-objective structural stages, episode_credit option screen, observation_validity/cancel guards, native planning probe
experiments.headline: On prod, every headline number reproduces from the saved files. (1) contextual_execution clips contexts at ±3 SD in its own whitened coordinates: PCA of the raw support (linear), PCA of the z-scored support (linear + normalize), or per-feature z-scores (normalize + quadratic). Residual is ≤6.7e-16. Along raw feature axes the clip point is generally not 3 SD; with linear + normalize, offsets still change beyond 10 SD on one axis. (2) Every multi-objective structural decision matched a lexicographic rule in objective order. Only 8 decisions separate it from summed or Pareto rules, and a sum weighting the first objective at least 114x fits equally well. A risk-first ordering left AC with a one-command dump at -2492% of best on held-out contexts. (3) Prints were inflated by +0.5, about 6x the best achievable score. A terminal observation_validity flag left behaviour identical to unflagged reporting; only the receipt's cost and the learner's state fingerprint changed. The run stayed at -330% of best at 150 episodes, against 96% clean (inferred); cancelling those decisions kept it at 85%. Native planning was refused (422, no value model), as the docs describe.

key_numbers.note: ±3 SD in whitened coordinates; offsets <= radius at the clip

key_numbers.measure: Out-of-range band (2.5,3.5], 256 contexts, saturating correction vs base: ac / ow / 2a / vwap

key_numbers.note: only 8 discriminate; >=114x first-weighted sum also fits

key_numbers.measure: episode_credit options that changed proposals in 60 mm episodes
key_numbers.note: coherent_edits false, outcome_tier_exploration false, capacity 4, segment_exploration true

key_numbers.measure: Inflated prints at 150 episodes: unflagged = validity-flagged / cancel / clean

corrections: '±3 SD' holds in the learner's whitened coordinates only, not along raw feature axes.
'Strictly lexicographic' overclaims: a sum weighting the first objective >=114x fits all 30 decisions equally.
Extrapolation band values from 32 contexts are noisy (256-context reruns move single values by up to 83 pts); the conclusion holds.
The +0.5 inflation is about 6x the best achievable AC score, so the takeover size is fixed by the corruption size.
The 'API-saturating' extrapolation arm assumes retained maps clip like pending candidates (verified on the API elsewhere for linear and normalize+quadratic, not for linear+normalize).

experiments.title: Refinement search geometry and budget allocation: guided candidate_count, contexts per update, radius and trust region (2a), and linear updates x contexts x candidates at equal executions (ac)
experiments.headline: With response guidance, 3 candidates per update stalled two-asset refinement near 47% of best (A 47.5% after 1,920 executions, B 47.0%, C 47.2%, base 39.6%). The 8-candidate control reached 74.4% at the same 1,920 executions and 80.6% at 2,560, and a 5-candidate extension reached 63.6% at 1,200 (control 62.4% there). The trust region was not inert. On linear AC at 2,560 executions, 40x8 scored 83.0-86.6%, 20x16 79.0-83.3%, 10x32 77.8% and 4 candidates 68.0%, and 60 updates reached 93.0% against a 93.6% linear ceiling. All results are single runs per configuration, and seed effects are as large as the allocation effects.

key_numbers.note: guided steps 0.73-0.94, offsets at the clip

key_numbers.measure: Regression of final share: log K / log U / log C
key_numbers.note: 4 residual df; log K rests on one K=4 arm

corrections: At matched 1,920 executions the K=3 vs K=8 gap is about 27 pts (headline compared against 2,560).
Regression rows are not independent (U60 checkpoints from one learner), so its SEs overstate precision.
Single runs per configuration; the 40x8 vs 20x16 ordering flips between seeds.
